guard: structured no-mesh failures retain a remedy whose terminal continuation aligns under the remedy text
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/cli-pty.smoke.ts

mutations.name: a no-mesh refusal drops its structured remedy
mutations.find: return parts("no mesh running", "run `cotal up` in a project, or pass `--server`");
mutations.cell: a failure on a 40-column terminal wraps under its text
mutations.expectRed: a failure on a 40-column terminal wraps under its text
